helpDraw: d                        Turn one card from the stock (redeal when empty, twice)
helpDirection: dir a | dir d            Fix the foundation direction (up/down, once per game)
helpMoveBrF: m br f                   Braid tail to a foundation
helpMoveFdF: m fd <idx> f             Braid field to a foundation (refills from the braid)
helpMoveHpF: m hp <idx> f             Helper to a foundation
helpMoveWF: m w f                    Waste top to a foundation
helpMoveWHp: m w hp <idx>             Waste top into an empty helper
promptDirection: Enter the direction (a = up, d = down):

promptToZone: Enter the destination (f = foundation, hp = helper):

invalidDirection: Invalid direction: {{val}} (enter a for up or d for down)

hintChooseDirection: Hint: fix the direction first with dir a (up) or dir d (down)
